artifacts.name: hld.md
artifacts.description: HLD for HarvestLink: 12 components (8 core services + IDP, Kong routing, payment gateway, Snowflake), 21 integrations, 10 data flows, 3 NFRs mapped, 1 gap (FR-008 availability contradiction).

content.execution_summary:
• Extracted 9 explicitly-tagged FRs (FR-001..FR-009, preserving the document's own 3-digit numbering) and 3 NFR-relevant statements (availability, retention, regulatory-boundary — none explicitly tagged NFR-xx in source, assigned NFR-01..NFR-03 in document order) from Requirements.md.
• Produced 12 components (8 core services per Components Identified, plus 4 grounded-but-unlisted infra/external components: External-party IDP, Kong routing config, Payment Gateway, Snowflake — each cited to Technical touch check / Integration Landscape, not invented), 21 integrations, 10 data flows, 3 NFR mappings; 1 gap.
• Key decision: Transaction Routing Service (C-06) cites BOTH FR-005 (per Integration Landscape prose) and FR-006 (per the dependency diagram) for its payment-gateway link, since the source document attributes it differently in two places — both are preserved rather than arbitrarily picking one.
• Key decision: Reporting Service's Snowflake publish (DF-10, INT-21) is modeled as routed via Kong API Gateway, not direct, per EA4 and the Downstream Consumers section — even though the dependency diagram draws a direct dotted line.
• Gap: SLA Impact claims FR-008 needs 99.9% availability, but Components Identified calls the same FR-008 best-effort — a genuine contradiction in the source, flagged rather than silently resolved in either direction; NFR-01 is mapped only to C-03 (Traceability), not C-08 (Reporting).
• Reflection: verified all ids well-formed, sequential per category, and in document order; no ungrounded components (all 12 trace to explicit document text); checked against kb-L1-enterprise-architecture's component-type taxonomy (service/external_system/gateway) and integration-pattern conventions.
• Knowledge bases consulted: kb-L1-enterprise-architecture — used to classify all 12 component types and confirm REST/event integration patterns, and to validate the Kong-routing (not direct/ESB) pattern against EA4.
• Guardrails evaluated: gr-L1-output-schema-validator (pass), gr-L1-pii-detection (pass — 7 of 10 data flows correctly flagged PII, 3 correctly identified as aggregate/non-PII metrics), gr-L1-consistency-check (pass), gr-L1-hallucination-check (pass).
• Gaps or issues flagged: FR-008 availability target contradiction (99.9% vs best-effort) — needs clarification from the source document's author.

must_pass_gates: All 9 FRs (FR-001..FR-009) and all 3 NFRs appear in at least one item's traceability array or in gaps

FR-008 availability contradiction (SLA Impact vs Components Identified) is surfaced as a gap, not silently resolved
NFR-03 (facilitation-only posture) addressed_by includes exactly the 4 FRs the source names: C-01, C-03, C-04, C-06
